app.title: Internship Saathi
app.disclaimer: Demonstration prototype. Sample internships only. Not an official government portal.
app.offline_notice: You are offline. Recommendations require an active local connection.
app.footer_note: Designed for accessibility, first-time seekers, and rural youth empowerment.

welcome.hero_title: Discover Right Internship Opportunities Tailored For You
welcome.hero_desc: No resume or past experience required. Answer simple questions about your schooling, interests, and preferred location to find relevant opportunities in minutes.
welcome.key_feat_1_desc: Opportunities tailored for 10th pass, 12th pass, ITI, Diploma, and graduates.
welcome.key_feat_2_desc: Transparent match scores and truthful explanations for every recommendation.
welcome.key_feat_3_desc: Your information stays in your browser. No personal phone, Aadhaar, or sensitive data stored.

wizard.title: Internship Match Wizard
wizard.step_1_sub: Select the highest level of education you have completed or are enrolled in.
wizard.step_2_title: What skills do you have or want to use?
wizard.step_2_sub: Pick any skills you are familiar with. If you are a beginner, that is completely fine!
wizard.not_sure_skills: I am a beginner / Not sure yet
wizard.search_skills: Search skills (e.g. typing, excel, farming, wiring)...
wizard.drop_resume: Drag & drop or click to upload
wizard.resume_skills_note: You can deselect any skill by clicking on it below.
wizard.privacy_note: Your resume is processed in memory and never stored.
wizard.step_3_title: Which sectors are you interested in?
wizard.step_3_sub: Select one or more sectors you would like to explore.
wizard.step_4_title: Where would you like to work?
wizard.step_4_sub: Tell us your home state, district, and work mode preferences.
wizard.relocate_label: I am open to relocating to other districts or states
wizard.error_education: Please select your education to continue.
wizard.error_loading_options: Failed to load options from server.
wizard.error_fetching_recommendations: Failed to fetch recommendations from server.
